words.definition: adv. 轻易地；乐意地；迅速地

examples.en: Detailed information about the product is readily available online.
examples.zh: 该产品的详细信息在网上很容易查到。

examples.en: She readily agreed to help with the community project.
examples.zh: 她欣然同意协助这个社区项目。

words.usage: 常修饰动词：readily accept、agree、admit（欣然接受等）。readily available 为高频搭配，指容易获得；否定式 not readily available 指不易获得。
words.mnemonic: ready(备好的/乐意的)+ly → 欣然；轻易地

examples.en: He was arrested for trying to smuggle drugs across the border.
examples.zh: 他因企图越境走私毒品被捕。

examples.en: The refugees were smuggled into the country in fishing boats.
examples.zh: 难民被渔船偷运入境。

words.usage: 及物动词，宾语常为 goods、drugs 等；常用结构 smuggle sth into、across 或 out of a place。派生：smuggler n. 走私者；smuggling n. 走私。
collocations: smuggle across the border 越境走私
words.mnemonic: 谐音「斯马狗」——货藏狗身偷运 → 走私

words.definition: adj. 滑的；狡猾的；含糊的

examples.en: The roads were slippery after the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 大雪过后路面很滑。

examples.en: The witness gave slippery answers to avoid the key question.
examples.zh: 证人回答含糊其辞，回避关键问题。

words.usage: 既指路面湿滑，也指人狡黠不可信，如 a slippery customer。习语 a slippery slope 指滑坡式连锁恶果，阅读高频。比较级 slipperier 或 more slippery。
collocations: a slippery slope 滑坡；连锁恶果
words.mnemonic: slip(滑)+pery → 让人打滑 → 滑；狡猾

words.definition: adj. 阴暗的；忧郁的；黯淡的

examples.en: Economists paint a gloomy picture of the job market.
examples.zh: 经济学家对就业市场的描绘十分黯淡。

examples.en: He felt gloomy about the future after losing his job.
examples.zh: 失业后他对未来感到忧郁。

words.usage: 既形容天气、房间昏暗，也形容情绪或前景悲观：gloomy outlook、gloomy forecast（黯淡的前景/预测）。常用 be gloomy about sth。派生：gloom n. 忧郁；昏暗。
collocations: feel gloomy about 对…感到悲观
words.mnemonic: gloom(阴暗)+y → 阴暗忧郁 → 黯淡的

examples.en: The volcano ejected lava and ash over a wide area.
examples.zh: 火山将熔岩和火山灰喷向大片区域。

examples.en: Several spectators were ejected from the stadium for fighting.
examples.zh: 数名观众因斗殴被逐出体育场。

words.usage: 及物动词，常用结构 eject sb from somewhere（把某人逐出或弹出）。语境涵盖火山喷发、弹出光盘、体育驱逐出场。派生：ejection n. 喷出；驱逐。
collocations: eject sb from 把某人逐出
eject the disc 弹出光盘
words.mnemonic: e(出)+ject(扔) → 往外扔 → 逐出；喷射

words.definition: n. 宪章；特许状 vt. 包租；特许

examples.en: The UN Charter was signed in San Francisco in 1945.
examples.zh: 《联合国宪章》于1945年在旧金山签署。

examples.en: The company chartered a plane to deliver medical supplies.
examples.zh: 公司包机运送医疗物资。

words.usage: 名词大写常指重要宪章，如 the UN Charter。动词 charter a plane 或 bus 指包租；charter flight 指包机。派生：chartered adj. 特许的。

confusables.note: chatter 喋喋不休；tt 双写

collocations: the UN Charter 联合国宪章
charter a plane 包租飞机
words.mnemonic: charta(拉丁「纸」)+er → 纸上纲领 → 宪章

examples.en: Petroleum remains the world's most important energy source.
examples.zh: 石油仍是世界上最重要的能源。

examples.en: The country's economy depends heavily on petroleum exports.
examples.zh: 该国经济严重依赖石油出口。

words.usage: 不可数名词，正式用语，多见于技术与经济语境；美式口语汽油称 gas。相关词：petrochemical（石油化工的）；petrol n. 汽油（英式）。
words.mnemonic: petr(石)+oleum(油) → 石中之油 → 石油

examples.en: Three years elapsed before they met again.
examples.zh: 三年过去，他们才再次相见。

examples.en: Only a few seconds elapsed between the question and his reply.
examples.zh: 从提问到他回答只隔几秒。

words.usage: 不及物动词，主语只能是时间，正式书面语；常用完成时，如 years have elapsed。口语多用 pass 或 go by 代替。相关：the lapse of time（时间的流逝）。
words.mnemonic: e(出)+lapse(溜) → 时间溜走 → 消逝

words.definition: vi. 恶化；堕落；退化 adj. 堕落的

examples.en: The debate degenerated into a bitter quarrel.
examples.zh: 辩论恶化成激烈的争吵。

examples.en: His health degenerated rapidly after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后他的健康状况迅速恶化。

words.usage: 不及物动词，常与 into 连用：degenerate into chaos 或 violence（沦为一团糟/暴力）。作形容词读 dɪˈdʒenərət，指堕落的。派生：degeneration n. 退化。
collocations: degenerate into chaos 陷入混乱
words.mnemonic: de(坏)+generate(生) → 变坏 → 恶化；堕落

examples.en: In fables the fox is often portrayed as a sly animal.
examples.zh: 在寓言中狐狸常被描绘成狡猾的动物。

examples.en: She gave him a sly smile before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 离开房间前她冲他诡秘地一笑。

words.usage: 形容人狡黠、暗中算计，略带贬义；a sly smile 或 glance 指「偷偷的、会心的」表情。习语 on the sly 意为偷偷地。派生：slyly adv. 狡猾地；slyness n. 狡猾。
collocations: a sly smile 诡秘一笑
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死赖」——死赖着算计 → 狡猾

words.definition: n. 后部；尾部 adj. 后面的 vt. 抚养；饲养

examples.en: The luggage compartment is located at the rear of the vehicle.
examples.zh: 行李舱位于车辆后部。

examples.en: It takes great patience to rear children properly.
examples.zh: 恰当抚养孩子需要极大耐心。

words.usage: 名词与形容词多指位置在后：rear door、rear seat；at 或 in the rear of（在…后部）。动词义为「抚养、饲养」。习语 bring up the rear 指殿后。

confusables.note: rare 稀有的；字母序不同

collocations: at the rear of 在…后部
bring up the rear 殿后
words.mnemonic: r+ear(耳) → 耳朵在头后部 → 后面

examples.en: Building the bridge in two years was an engineering feat.
examples.zh: 两年建成这座桥是一项工程壮举。

examples.en: Winning three gold medals is no small feat.
examples.zh: 赢得三枚金牌绝非易事。

words.usage: 常与 no small、a remarkable、an impressive 搭配：no small feat（绝非小事）。强调需技巧或勇气完成的成就。注意与 feet（脚）同音，靠语境区分词义。
collocations: a remarkable feat 非凡壮举
no small feat 绝非易事
an engineering feat 工程壮举
words.mnemonic: 与 feet(脚)同音 → 用脚闯出的伟业 → 功绩

examples.en: The bill was approved by the lower chamber of parliament.
examples.zh: 该法案获议会下议院批准。

examples.en: The heart has four chambers that pump blood around the body.
examples.zh: 心脏有四个腔室，把血液泵往全身。

words.usage: 政治语境指议院：the upper 或 lower chamber（上/下议院）；医学指心脏等腔室。合成词 chamber of commerce（商会）常见。比 room 正式，多具机构色彩。
words.mnemonic: cham(谐音「舱」)+ber → 舱室空间 → 议院

examples.en: They toasted the deal with a bottle of champagne.
examples.zh: 他们开了一瓶香槟庆祝交易达成。

examples.en: True champagne comes only from the Champagne region of France.
examples.zh: 真正的香槟只产自法国香槟地区。

words.usage: 法语借词，重音在第二音节，注意与 champion 区分。a bottle/glass of champagne 指一瓶/杯香槟；不可数。引申义「香槟色」较少考。
collocations: a bottle of champagne 一瓶香槟
pop the champagne 开香槟庆祝
words.mnemonic: 音译「香槟」——庆功开瓶 → 香槟酒

examples.en: Millions were persecuted for their religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 数百万人曾因宗教信仰遭受迫害。

examples.en: He claimed the tabloids were persecuting him unfairly.
examples.zh: 他声称小报在不公正地迫害他。

words.usage: 及物动词，指因种族、宗教或政治观点持续迫害；被动 be persecuted for sth 高频。辨析：prosecute（起诉）为法律程序，二者形近易混。派生：persecution n. 迫害。
collocations: persecute sb for 因…迫害某人
be persecuted for 因…受迫害
words.mnemonic: per(一直)+secute(跟) → 一直追着害 → 迫害

words.definition: n. 一堆；大量 v. 堆积

examples.en: There was a pile of unwashed dishes in the sink.
examples.zh: 水槽里堆着一摞没洗的盘子。

examples.en: Debts began to pile up after he lost his job.
examples.zh: 失业后他的债务开始越积越多。

words.usage: 名词短语 a pile of 或 piles of 指「成堆的」。动词短语 pile up 意为堆积、（车辆）连环相撞；pile into 挤进。派生：piled adj. 堆起的。
words.mnemonic: 谐音「派哦」——派出一大堆 → 一堆

examples.en: The recipe calls for a quart of milk.
examples.zh: 这份食谱需要一夸脱牛奶。

examples.en: He added a quart of oil to the engine.
examples.zh: 他往发动机里加了一夸脱机油。

words.usage: 英制与美制容量单位：美制1夸脱约0.95升，英制约1.14升；4 quarts 等于1 gallon。与 quarter（四分之一）同源，quarter 曾指四分之一夸脱。
collocations: a quart of milk 一夸脱牛奶
a quart of oil 一夸脱机油
two quarts of water 两夸脱水
words.mnemonic: 与 quarter 同源 → 一加仑的四分之一 → 夸脱

words.definition: n. 检疫；隔离 vt. 隔离

examples.en: The patient was placed in quarantine for two weeks.
examples.zh: 病人被隔离了两周。

examples.en: All animals imported into the country must be quarantined.
examples.zh: 所有进口动物必须接受检疫隔离。

words.usage: 名词搭配 be in 或 under quarantine（处于隔离中）、quarantine period（隔离期）。动词及物：quarantine sb/sth。公共卫生语境高频词。
collocations: be placed in quarantine 被隔离
words.mnemonic: quar(四十)+antine → 隔离四十天 → 检疫

examples.en: You can buy this medicine without a prescription at any pharmacy.
examples.zh: 这种药无需处方，在任何药店都能买到。

examples.en: She is studying pharmacy at a leading university.
examples.zh: 她在顶尖大学攻读药剂学。

words.usage: 指实体药店或药剂学学科；美式口语也用 drugstore（兼售杂货）。派生：pharmacist n. 药剂师；pharmaceutical adj. 制药的。
words.mnemonic: pharm(药)+acy → 卖药之处 → 药房；药剂学

words.definition: adj. 封建的；封建制度的

examples.en: The country remained a feudal society until the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 该国直到19世纪仍是封建社会。

examples.en: Feudal lords held vast power over the peasants.
examples.zh: 封建领主对农民握有巨大权力。

words.usage: 历史与社科阅读高频：feudal society、feudal system（封建社会/制度）、feudal lord（封建领主）。派生：feudalism n. 封建主义。
words.mnemonic: feud(封地)+al → 封地制度的 → 封建的
